description: This file defines the class 'MonkeySourceRandomScript', which implements the 'MonkeyEventSource' interface. It manages the generation of 'MonkeyEvent' objects from multiple scripts, including optional setup scripts, and supports randomization of script execution order. It includes methods for event retrieval, validation, and verbosity control.

classes.name: MonkeySourceRandomScript
classes.description: Manages multiple script sources for generating MonkeyEvents with options for setup script, randomization, and validation.

methods.name: MonkeySourceRandomScript
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with an optional setup script and a list of script filenames, setting parameters such as throttle, randomization, and a random generator.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next MonkeyEvent from the current script source; switches sources when current is exhausted.

methods.name: setVerbose
methods.description: Sets verbosity level for this source and all contained script sources.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates all script sources to ensure they are correct and ready for execution.
